Lumen OS: SHA-256 of the DER of each PUBLIC AOSP test certificate (build/make/target/product/security/*.x509.pem, Lineage 21 uses them unchanged; copies in tools/sign/testcerts) -> the Lumen release key (~/.lumen-keys/<name>.pk8 + .x509.pem) that replaces it. sign_tar.py re-signs every APK whose signer is a key here, rewrites the SELinux mac_permissions certs, and fails on any APK signed by an unmapped Android test-looking certificate.

known_test_only.ce7b2b47ae2b7552c8f92cc29124279883041fb6: cts_uicc_2021 (CTS carrier-privilege test cert; never signs a system APK; listed so the leftover scan knows it)
